optional_dependency_policy.standalone_first: Prefer a tested EEGPrep-owned Python implementation when the workflow is core preprocessing, data structure, GUI, console, or saved-file behavior.
optional_dependency_policy.optional_dependency: Use optional_dependency only when the scientific computation depends on a substantial external toolbox that can be installed, versioned, tested, and documented without reading the vendored EEGLAB tree.
optional_dependency_policy.external_plugin: Use external_plugin when the workflow belongs to a third-party EEGLAB ecosystem that should live behind EEGPrep extension contracts instead of core package runtime code.
optional_dependency_policy.user_facing_failure: Unsupported optional paths must raise clear user-facing limitations, name the missing backend, and link to EEGPrep docs rather than creating placeholder outputs.

docs_architecture.model: EEGLAB-style user manual, rewritten for standalone EEGPrep Python, Qt GUI, and eegprep-console behavior.

source_exclusion_policy: Exclude plugins/clean_rawdata/manopt/manopt/** because it is a vendored third-party Manopt library, not an EEGPrep user workflow; Riemannian ASR remains represented by the top-level ASR and Manopt entry rows.
Exclude plugins/clean_rawdata/manopt/examples/** and plugins/clean_rawdata/manopt/tests/** because they are third-party demos/tests.
Exclude plugins/ICLabel/matconvnet/** and plugins/ICLabel/tests/** because EEGPrep uses packaged Python ICLabel assets/runtime decisions instead of porting MatConvNet internals.
metadata.runtime_rule: Installed eegprep package code must not read, import from, or shell out to src/eegprep/eeglab; that tree is only a development and parity-test oracle.

rows.title: clean_rawdata cleaning pipeline and GUI entry point
rows.rationale: Phase 2 completed the standalone cleaning audit: pop_clean_rawdata and clean_artifacts cover the useful EEGLAB cleaning sequence, GUI defaults stay synchronized with console history, progress/output behavior is test-covered, and visual diagnostics now route through packaged EEGPrep code.
rows.test_notes: Covered by clean_rawdata unit tests, sample_data pop_clean_rawdata regressions, GUI spec tests, visual checkbox diagnostics tests, and focused nonfinite/progress regressions.

rows.title: Standard ASR calibration and processing
rows.rationale: Standard ASR calibration, processing, and clean_asr integration are native Python paths with deterministic edge-case coverage; Phase 2 keeps this as the supported standalone ASR workflow.
rows.test_notes: Covered by tests/test_clean_asr.py, tests/test_utils_asr.py, tests/test_clean_artifacts.py, and sample_data pop_clean_rawdata ASR regressions; MATLAB-only numerical differences remain documented as implementation tradeoffs.

rows.title: Riemannian ASR and Manopt-backed behavior

optional_dependency.name: Riemannian manifold optimizer for ASR
optional_dependency.fallback_behavior: Use the supported standard ASR path, or the calibration-time Riemannian estimate, and raise a clear limitation when a user explicitly requests full Riemannian ASR processing.
optional_dependency.user_message: Full Riemannian ASR processing is not silently emulated in standalone EEGPrep; use standard ASR or useriemannian='calib' until a tested Python manifold-optimization backend is selected.
optional_dependency.phase_contract: Phase 2 keeps Manopt-backed processing as a documented optional-dependency limitation and covers both the calibration-time path and explicit failure path.

rows.rationale: EEGLAB bundles Manopt for full Riemannian ASR. EEGPrep deliberately does not vendor or read that MATLAB library at runtime; it supports the useful calibration-time variant and rejects full processing clearly.
rows.test_notes: Covered by clean_asr and clean_artifacts tests for useriemannian='calib', sample_data Riemannian calibration regressions, and explicit full-Riemannian failure-path tests.

rows.title: clean_rawdata private numerical helpers
rows.rationale: Phase 2 keeps clean_rawdata's product-relevant private numerics consolidated into native Python statistics, signal-processing, covariance, and interpolation modules instead of recreating MATLAB private-file boundaries.
rows.test_notes: Covered by existing private numerical utility tests, ASR utility tests, clean_channels/clean_windows regressions, and FIR/filter integration tests where the helpers surface through user workflows.

rows.title: clean_rawdata MATLAB helper and GUI shims
rows.rationale: These MATLAB convenience helpers should stay folded into Python error handling, kwargs, and array utilities rather than becoming public EEGPrep files.
rows.test_notes: Phase 2 audit found no user-facing workflow requiring standalone ports; kwargs parsing, chunking, cache-free execution, and native exceptions remain covered through clean_rawdata integration tests.

rows.title: clean_rawdata artifact visualization
rows.rationale: EEGPrep now provides native vis_artifacts-style diagnostics and wires pop_clean_rawdata's visual checkbox to the packaged eegplot-backed viewer without a runtime EEGLAB dependency.
rows.test_notes: Covered by diagnostics unit tests and pop_clean_rawdata GUI visual-checkbox tests; PR visual evidence covers the updated dialog path.

rows.title: FIRFilt current filtering APIs
rows.rationale: Phase 2 completed useful FIRFilt current API parity with DC-padded filtering, boundary-aware segmentation, report/progress output, response plotting hooks, and GUI callback metadata.
rows.test_notes: Covered by tests/test_pop_firfilt.py, tests/test_firfilt_helpers.py, GUI FIRFilt dialog tests, and MATLAB-marked deterministic helper parity where local MATLAB is available.

rows.title: FIRFilt order calculators and window helpers
rows.rationale: EEGPrep now exposes EEGLAB-named FIRFilt order/window helpers, command-returning pop_* wrappers, Qt dialog specs, live estimate/plot callback metadata, packaged help, and visual parity capture cases.
rows.test_notes: Covered by deterministic kaiser/window/order tests, command history tests, dialog spec tests, and visual parity manifest/script-generation tests.

rows.title: FIRFilt boundary helpers, reports, and response plots
rows.rationale: Boundary-aware split helpers, user-readable FIRFilt reports, minimum-phase conversion, Gaussian helper behavior, and native Matplotlib frequency-response plots are now explicit EEGPrep plugin surfaces.
rows.test_notes: Covered by first/last boundary tests, firfiltsplit/fir_filterdcpadded regressions, report text tests, and plotfresp smoke tests using the non-interactive Matplotlib backend.

rows.title: ICLabel classification pipeline
rows.phase_issue: #163 ICLabel, viewprops, and visual diagnostics completion
rows.rationale: EEGPrep has standalone ICLabel feature extraction, default netICL classification, ICLabel flagging, label statistics, menu wiring, and history-capable pop wrappers. The default Python network is packaged; EEGLAB lite/beta artifacts are explicit MATLAB/Octave passthrough choices and raise a clear standalone limitation instead of being silently ignored.
rows.test_notes: Covered by ICLabel feature/parity tests, GUI pop wrapper tests, sample-data ICLabel-state statistics tests, and explicit standalone alternate-network limitation tests.

rows.title: ICLabel label statistics
rows.phase_issue: #163 ICLabel, viewprops, and visual diagnostics completion
rows.rationale: EEGPrep now provides an EEGPrep-owned `eeg_icalabelstat` helper that preserves EEGLAB threshold-count output and returns structured Python statistics for reports, rejection review, and tests.
rows.test_notes: Covered by deterministic label-distribution tests, missing/malformed ICLabel-state tests, class-specific threshold tests, rejected/kept tally tests, packaged help, and sample-data ICA/ICLabel-state integration coverage.

rows.title: Viewprops component browser
rows.phase_issue: #163 ICLabel, viewprops, and visual diagnostics completion
rows.rationale: EEGPrep has native Qt/matplotlib component-property surfaces for viewprops: component and channel overview entry points, browser-backed activity traces, extended component dashboards with scalp maps, spectra, ERP/image summaries, ICLabel probability panels, accept/reject controls, and DIPFIT overlays when localized models are present.
rows.test_notes: Covered by pop_viewprops/pop_prop_extended GUI and data-model tests, browser-backed activity tests, rejection dashboard commit/cancel tests, menu/session sync tests, visual parity cases, and sample-data history integration coverage.

rows.title: MatConvNet activation shim
rows.rationale: This modifies MATLAB paths and MatConvNet state. EEGPrep must use packaged Python runtime assets and must not activate vendored MATLAB libraries.
rows.test_notes: Runtime-boundary tests should continue preventing package code from reading src/eegprep/eeglab.

rows.title: ICLabel developer tests and packaging helpers
rows.rationale: These are MATLAB plugin developer helpers, not EEGPrep user workflows or runtime behavior.
rows.test_notes: No runtime parity tests required; EEGPrep has its own Python test and packaging workflow.

rows.title: DIPFIT settings and dataset metadata
rows.rationale: EEGPrep stores EEGLAB-compatible DIPFIT metadata, template choices, channel selections, GUI help, and replayable console history without using the vendored EEGLAB tree at runtime.
user_facing_surface: Tools > Locate dipoles using DIPFIT > Head model and settings
rows.test_notes: Covered by DIPFIT settings tests for standard templates, channel omission, GUI application to multiple datasets, sample-data setup, and replayable command history.

rows.title: DIPFIT fitting and FieldTrip-backed source localization
rows.rationale: EEGPrep now provides deterministic standalone spherical grid search, nonlinear moment/position refinement, multifit, deprecated batch/manual aliases, RV rejection, and explicit-point spherical leadfield construction. MRI-derived BEM headmodel creation, AFNI atlas leadfield preparation, and LORETA source analysis remain explicit missing-backend limitations rather than fake FieldTrip outputs.
rows.test_notes: Covered by synthetic known-source DIPFIT tests, nonlinear refinement, multifit, batch/manual aliases, explicit-point leadfield generation, RV rejection, and remaining limitation-path tests for MRI headmodel, unsupported source-model files, and LORETA.

rows.title: DIPFIT dipole plotting
rows.rationale: EEGPrep plots existing dipole positions and moments, honors RV filtering and key EEGLAB dipplot options, and uses packaged standard MNI MRI slices for summary/projection views. Custom MRI and FieldTrip mesh rendering remain explicit asset/backend limits.
rows.test_notes: Covered by dipplot command-history, localized-component selection, missing-model errors, MRI slice helper tests, and visual parity dialog cases.

rows.title: DIPFIT atlas, coordinate, and transform helpers
rows.rationale: EEGPrep now has standalone NumPy/SciPy ports for DIPFIT MNI/Talairach and spherical transforms, homogeneous/traditional transforms, warp application/optimization, head-coordinate construction, FieldTrip-to-EEGLAB channel conversion, and fiducial/template electrode realignment. AFNI/NIfTI atlas loading is explicit through nibabel when available and does not pretend to run FieldTrip head-model clipping for unsupported cases.
rows.test_notes: Covered by deterministic mni2tal, headcoordinates, traditional transform, warp_apply, electroderealign, and atlas/backend limitation tests.

rows.title: MATLAB @eegobj class facade
rows.rationale: EEGPrep should preserve EEG dict semantics and session behavior rather than porting MATLAB object overloads one-for-one.
rows.test_notes: Phase 5 should verify object/storage behavior through public EEG dict, save/load, GUI, and console workflows.

rows.title: @eegobj MATLAB developer simpletest
rows.rationale: This is a MATLAB class developer test, not a user workflow. EEGPrep uses Python unit and integration tests instead.
rows.test_notes: No parity port required; validator coverage prevents it from being forgotten.

rows.title: MATLAB @memmapdata large-array behavior
rows.rationale: EEGPrep implements the user-visible large-array behavior with a NumPy-compatible .fdt memory-map handle and two-file save/load semantics instead of porting MATLAB class overloads directly.
rows.test_notes: Phase 5 verifies first/last sample access, sidecar mutation, missing-sidecar failure, save/load round trips, and a slow memmap load smoke in tests/test_storage.py.

rows.title: MATLAB @mmo memory-mapped object operations
rows.rationale: These MATLAB overloads represent storedisk-era memory-mapped operations. EEGPrep implements the user-visible contract through explicit offloaded dataset handles, shared session retrieval, and deterministic save/load behavior.
rows.test_notes: Phase 5 verifies storedisk offload/rehydrate, unsaved-dataset refusal, pop_newset behavior, STUDY resave, and mixed session/console synchronization in tests/test_eeg_store_storedisk.py and tests/test_console_workspace.py.

rows.title: LIMO-compatible STUDY workflows
rows.phase_issue: #161 STUDY statistics, PAC, and LIMO-compatible workflows

optional_dependency.name: LIMO-compatible statistics backend
optional_dependency.fallback_behavior: Build standalone design matrices with std_limodesign, and keep explicit NotImplementedError limitations for model execution and result browsing until EEGPrep owns or integrates a tested LIMO-compatible backend.
optional_dependency.user_message: EEGPrep builds LIMO-compatible design matrices but does not silently emulate EEGLAB LIMO model fitting, result computation, or browsing.
optional_dependency.phase_contract: Phase 4 implements the feasible standalone design layer and documents the external backend boundary for fitting/results.

rows.rationale: LIMO is a separate MATLAB toolbox-level workflow. EEGPrep now owns design-matrix preparation while keeping model fitting and result browsing behind explicit external-backend limitations.
rows.test_notes: Phase 4 tests std_limodesign matrix/export behavior and keeps limitation tests for model/result entry points; placeholder LIMO outputs are not acceptable.

rows.title: PAC compute, cache, and plot workflows
rows.phase_issue: #161 STUDY statistics, PAC, and LIMO-compatible workflows
rows.rationale: PAC now has a tested EEGPrep-owned compute/cache/plot path for practical channel workflows. Unsupported PAC bootstrap and latphase variants raise explicit limitations rather than fake results.
rows.test_notes: Focused tests cover pac, pac_cont, std_pac cache writing, std_readpac slicing, std_pacplot replayable commands, and unsupported PAC statistics boundaries.

rows.title: FieldTrip-style STUDY neighbor, interpolation, and dipole cluster workflows
rows.phase_issue: #161 STUDY statistics, PAC, and LIMO-compatible workflows
rows.rationale: EEGPrep now owns STUDY channel interpolation and distance-based neighbor/adjacency preparation. STUDY dipole cluster/source plotting remains an explicit DIPFIT/FieldTrip backend boundary coordinated with Phase 3.
rows.test_notes: Focused tests cover neighbor adjacency, STUDY interpolation, and explicit source-workflow limitation paths.

rows.title: History, console, and EEGLAB command migration tutorial
rows.rationale: Phase 7 added the EEGPrep-owned console and migration guides that map EEGLAB command-history habits to eegprep-console, LASTCOM, ALLCOM, GUI session updates, and replayable Python commands.
rows.test_notes: Covered by the Sphinx docs build, interactive-console examples, GUI/console session docs, and Phase 8 closeout review of shared-session smoke coverage.

rows.title: Event processing tutorials
rows.rationale: Phase 7 added concepts and migration coverage for event latency, urevent, epoch, STUDY event handling, and explicit MATLAB-facing versus Python-indexing boundaries.
rows.test_notes: Covered by the Sphinx docs build and by existing pop_adjustevents, epoching, STUDY trialinfo, and migration-guide examples referenced from the manual.

rows.title: STUDY creation, ERP, and group workflow tutorials
rows.rationale: Phase 7 expanded STUDY documentation into task-oriented GUI, console, scripting, cache, ERP, PAC, clustering, and limitation guidance based on completed Phase 4 behavior.
rows.test_notes: Covered by the Sphinx docs build, STUDY workflow examples, and existing STUDY cache/design/PAC tests that anchor the documented behavior.

rows.title: Source reconstruction tutorials
rows.rationale: Phase 7 documented the implemented dataset-level DIPFIT spherical workflows and the explicit MRI/BEM, AFNI atlas clipping, LORETA, FieldTrip, and STUDY source-statistics backend boundaries defined by Phase 3.
rows.test_notes: Covered by the Sphinx docs build, DIPFIT workflow docs, plugins guide, and existing DIPFIT implementation and limitation-path tests.

rows.title: Time-frequency and EEG movie tutorials
rows.rationale: Phase 7 documented the supported preprocessing and time-frequency-adjacent workflow surfaces while keeping EEG movie and visual parity capture behavior as explicit tooling or future-work boundaries.
rows.test_notes: Covered by the Sphinx docs build, preprocessing tutorial examples, visual parity tooling docs, and existing time-frequency/core parity test coverage.

rows.title: BIDS face-experiment tutorial
rows.rationale: Phase 7 added a standalone BIDS workflow tutorial covering EEGLAB .set/.fdt export, BIDS file listing, sidecar-aware loading, batch preprocessing, derivative loading, and GUI/console menu flow.
rows.test_notes: Covered by the Sphinx docs build, BIDS workflow examples, and existing BIDS import/export/preprocessing tests.
